name: SurgeXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: The open-source Surge XT synth engine, headless, for Gen1: 2 scenes of 3 oscillators, dual filters, 6 LFOs per scene, mod matrix, 16 FX slots and 8 macros on eight pages. Loads every factory and third-party patch (3008) and wavetable (761), plus your own. Install it on its own (about 450 MB). MPC OS 3.x.
